propositions: Four dispatch call sites use cast() to widen transport type to optional capability Protocols but perform no runtime guard, so AttributeError on missing capability is silently swallowed by broad exception handlers instead of surfacing as designed skip
isinstance() runtime guards against @runtime_checkable capability Protocols must replace cast-only assertions at all four call sites before invoking add_comment and set_relationship methods

Capability-absent condition must be observable via bridge_alerts channel with distinct alert kind and INFO log, while capability-present-but-raised errors must remain in existing failure path with comment_errors
Module size constraint (800 LOC cap) requires relocation of _call_with_retry (~75 lines) from dispatch_one.py to dispatch_apply_phases.py to make room for guard logic

isinstance checks fail on proxying transports in Python 3.12+ (getattr_static does not see __getattr__ attributes) so fallback hasattr member checks are required alongside isinstance for production safety
